versions.content: Service Name Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpTxConfirmation_<CGI> Syntax void Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpTxConfirmation_<CGI> ( Std_ReturnType result ) Service ID [hex] 0xTBD Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant Parameters (in) result E_OK - transmission successful. E_NOT_OK - transmission not successful. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Rte_Rips_NotifyTpTxConfirmation will be called to notify the RTE Implementation Plug-In that a Signal has been transmitted via the TP-API for the LdCom signal used for the Data Communication Graph requiring transformation. The provided result parameter indicates whether the transmission was successful or not.This function is designed to be a plug-in proxy for the LdCom TP Rte_LdComCbkTpTxConfirmation callback. See requirement [SWS_ LDCOM_00056] for more details on the functionality of this callback. Available via Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h
